preferenceFix.problem: Periodic/pagehide preference snapshots captured empty/default localStorage while initial bridge hydration was pending, then wrote the stale dump after approval/readback, overwriting last-good ls_prefs/all values. Read failure also allowed empty snapshots and repeated writes could land out of order.
preferenceFix.behavior: Snapshotting requires authoritative successful hydration, captures values after bridge readiness, serializes repeated requests and drains newer edits, uses queue:false, and leaves failed writes retryable. A hydration retry waits for an in-flight write before reading. Failed or pending hydration cannot publish an empty/default snapshot.

Includes mixed dataURI/blob next-save preservation, explicit media removal, real quota rejection fallback and non-quota failure propagation.

mixedResourceEvidence.coverage: Actual host snapshot builder captures 15 distinct resource shapes including Original exact text/annotations, Adapted source snapshot, glossary image/definition, quiz, FAQ, frames, Cornell notes, memory prompts, discussion, applied challenge, organizer, sequence, Directions choices, teacher Analysis and visual/audio supports. mixedResourceEvidence.scope: Controlled native-API and bridge mocks only. No network, real device storage, deletion, import, credential/account changes or deployment. Resource data are representative fixtures; content instructional validity is not asserted.

inventoryDiagnosis.finding: Saved work categories count matching managed localStorage/IDB keys, classified heuristically by key name; count 42 is not a count of 42 recoverable resources. These totals are merged separately from durable namespace rows and recovery snapshot count. A 42-key/~23KB category fixture coexists with an empty recovery store. None of these summaries proves the old live resource bytes are recoverable or irreversibly lost.
inventoryDiagnosis.namespaceSeparation: ls_prefs/all mirrors localStorage preferences/managed values; app_kv mirrors older storageDB cache values; workspace_recovery/store_v1 contains explicit workspace snapshots. The proven preference race affects ls_prefs and does not establish why old live workspace_recovery appeared empty.
inventoryDiagnosis.emptyMetadataBytes: Current recovery.emptyStore() with legacyMigrationComplete:true serializes to exactly 150 UTF-8 bytes, consistent with the size of metadata-only empty recovery observed live. This size match does not identify the live contents, earlier state, or cause.

loadingDiagnosis.finding: Current background pump parks under document.hidden or concealed/launch-pad classes and explicit promotion bypasses it; previous actual-source tests verify pause/resume, input starvation release and ReadingLibrary promotion. Conceal state is derived from readiness/mode, while recovery separately gates deep-link launch. No deployed post-reload root cause has been established.
loadingDiagnosis.remainingEvidence: Inspect frozen candidate's actual registry pending/queued/failed snapshot, body conceal/launch-pad state, promoted requested modules and storage readiness/consent state in the real browser; do not infer network stalls merely from a queued count.
